cases.name: Melissa Sue Ostrom
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Melissa never knew a stranger. She was a true “social butterfly” with a kindred spirit and so much kindness toward everyone. She was a talented artist and writer. She had a contagious smile and laugh, and she gave the best hugs. Most of all she cherished her family. She was a beautiful soul and will be missed by so many. She is now with our Lord and Savior Jesus for eternity." Ostrom’s family affectionately called her “Missie” or “Kissy Missie.” “She was a kissy bandit. She would kiss your car windows and leave her little name there, and write her name in lipstick. She was an artist so she liked to leave her mark,” said her aunt, (who) described Ostrom as a light who loved to help people. “She loved children. Children were drawn to her like magnets. She would dance and paint and do crafts with them,” Bicknell said.
